title: Facility Operations Manual: Vehicle Compliance Notices and Compliance Termination for the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Obligation.** Under the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement the tenant must keep a current registration and liability insurance on file for the vehicle, and the vehicle must stay operable. The registration, insurance and operability requirements apply where the class requires a current registration, current insurance and an operable vehicle.

**Compliance notice.** When the registration or insurance on file has expired, or the facility logs the vehicle as inoperable or longer than the space allows, a compliance notice is sent giving the cure period of the class, in calendar days from the notice date, to cure. Each compliance problem is noticed once per cycle; a compliance notice's cycle runs from the expiry or inspection date of the problem, and a termination notice's cycle runs from the compliance notice date.

**Compliance termination notice.** A compliance termination notice may be sent only when the handling date is later than the compliance notice date plus the cure period of the class. Cure days are calendar days starting the day after the notice date, and a cure on the last day is in time. The termination notice sets a termination date the termination notice period of the class after its own date and moves the agreement to termination-noticed standing.

**Recording a renewal — partly no longer in force.** The words that a renewed registration or insurance is recorded when the tenant states the new expiry date exactly as printed on the document are **no longer in force**; they have been superseded. The rest of that sentence stands: a cure recorded before the termination date returns an agreement under a compliance termination notice to active.

**Unpaid balances.** An unpaid balance is handled under the tow process, not as a compliance problem.

### Cure-period boundary (hypothetical, 30-day cure period)

| Compliance notice date | Last cure day | Termination notice may be sent from |
|---|---|---|
| 3 March | 2 April (day 30 counted from 4 March) — a cure on 2 April is in time | 3 April |

Hypothetical termination date: a termination notice dated 3 April on a class with a 30-day termination notice period sets a termination date of 3 May.

### Points of judgement

- Insurance on file expired, facility log otherwise clear: a compliance notice applies.
- Rent unpaid but documents current and vehicle operable: not a compliance problem; the tow process governs.
- The same expired registration already noticed in its cycle: it is not noticed again in that cycle.

superseded_clauses: A renewed registration or insurance is recorded when the tenant states the new expiry date exactly as printed on the document
